# Release constraints (spec section 1 "Packaging"); use with pip's -c.
# binary-galactica 0.5.0 (the PyPI release) restores the physical amplitude: its native GLASS
# vector is gbonfly's (0.4.0 templates were exactly half).  wdm_models refuses anything older than
# 0.5.0 at import of its waveform (wdm_models.galactic_binary.waveform.check_binary_galactica).
binary-galactica==0.5.0
# env/requirements-bg.txt installs this PyPI release on top of the env (pip --no-deps --force-reinstall).
# impulse v2 (impulse-mcmc 2.0.0, commit 964283c on origin/v2) for the GLASS foreground MAP and the
# sampling runners: not on PyPI, whose impulse-mcmc 1.0.0 is the pre-rewrite API.  The
# wdm-models[sampling] extra asks for impulse-mcmc>=2 (no PyPI release satisfies it); this
# constraint supplies the commit (pip >= 20.3 accepts a named URL constraint):
#     $PY -m pip install -c env/constraints.txt "impulse-mcmc>=2"
impulse-mcmc @ git+https://github.com/AaronDJohnson/impulse_mcmc@964283c
